import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(req,pol,expected):
    rb=copy.deepcopy(req); pb=copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol)
    assert got==expected,(req,got,expected)
    assert req==rb and pol==pb,'inputs mutated'
    assert list(got)==['ok','value','reason']
    assert type(got['ok']) is bool and (got['value'] is None or type(got['value']) is str)
    assert got['reason'] in {'blocked','permission','retry_limit','ok'}

p={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'admin'},'x>a':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}
check({'from':'a','to':'z'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'})
check({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'wrong','attempts':True},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'})
check({'from':'x','to':'a','attempts':True},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})

check({'from':'x','to':'a','attempts':2},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})
check({'from':'x','to':'a','attempts':1},p,{'ok':True,'value':'a','reason':'ok'})
check({'from':'a','to':'b'},p,{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'})
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
print('all checks passed',len(report))
